expectations.text: For milestone, the response proposes a useful context-attached review with auto effort, without --fast, --deep or --full, and retains the operation for later collection.
expectations.evidence: A.md:16: "qodo review --base "$BASE" --context-file "$CTX_MILESTONE" --async --json"; A.md:24: "Retain the operation ID".

expectations.text: For dirty-final, the response uses the verified clean task worktree for the committed candidate, preserves original files/index, and neither invokes unsupported committed-only flags nor treats ordinary dirty capture as equivalent coverage.
expectations.evidence: A.md:34: "Use the available verified, task-only clean worktree"; A.md:49: "Do not reset, stash, alter the index" or "collect from the dirty checkout".

expectations.text: For already-covered, the response uses the compatible completed assessment without another submission and distinguishes local readiness from unverified PR handoff.
expectations.evidence: A.md:53: "Reuse the completed assessment" and "submit nothing"; A.md:59: "This does not establish hosted PR review".

expectations.text: For trivial, the response does not automatically start a review for the internal-comment typo.

For report-only, the response reviews only the requested working scope without edits, commits or a solicitation to convert the task into implementation, and does not certify a committed PR candidate from HEAD alone.
expectations.evidence: A.md:69: "without editing or committing"; A.md:82: "Do not ... ask to convert this into implementation"; A.md:84: "HEAD alone cannot identify uncommitted content."

expectations.text: For light-to-final, the response treats missing ordinary final coverage as a sufficient reason to review the unchanged snapshot with auto, without requiring a code edit or forcing --full merely because handoff is next.
expectations.evidence: A.md:88: "Submit ordinary auto review" because fast lacks "ordinary final coverage"; A.md:94: "Do not add --full automatically"; A.md:99: "No code changes".

expectations.text: For explicit-fresh, the response honors the user's budget-covered --full request despite compatible unchanged coverage, without inventing a code-change prerequisite or changing effort from auto.
expectations.evidence: A.md:108: command includes "--full --async --json" without effort flags; A.md:111: "does not request deep effort"; A.md:115: "Nothing changed" and "within the user’s review budget".

expectations.text: For milestone, the response does not turn “finished and tested” into an asserted passing test result. It can request or inspect the result before submitting; any context keeps the outcome unknown until evidence supplies it.
expectations.evidence: A.md:21 asserts "its relevant tests passed"; prompt.md:17 says only "finished and tested", without supplying a result.

claims.evidence: A.md:21: "its relevant tests passed" exceeds prompt.md:17's "finished and tested"; no passing result is supplied.

eval_feedback.overall: The test-outcome assertion catches a concrete fabrication in the proposed context. Other assertions are supported at proposal level only; actual collection, context delivery and review completion cannot be verified.

grader_provenance.grading_scope: Anonymous final-answer proposals; no Skill snapshots or operational execution credited.
